user.title: HA Timelapse Generator
user.description: Choose a private output directory inside a Home Assistant media directory (default /media/ha_tgen), or /config/ha_tgen. Add photo sources and schedules in the Timelapse sidebar panel after setup.

error.invalid_directory: Choose an absolute, writable directory inside a configured media directory or /config/ha_tgen.

generate.name: Generate timelapse
generate.description: Queue timelapse videos from configured photo sources.

camera_ids.name: Camera IDs
camera_ids.description: Select the stable IDs shown in the Timelapse panel.

mode.name: Period
mode.description: Previous week, previous month, year to date, or custom dates.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: Inclusive start date for custom mode.

end_date.name: End date
end_date.description: Inclusive end date for custom mode.

cancel.name: Cancel timelapse
cancel.description: Cancel a queued or running job.

job_id.name: Job ID
job_id.description: ID returned by the generate action.
